description: Register of promises AtliQ has already made in signed contracts. Entries with confirmed_by_human=false are proposals from 'Rebuild register' and are never used in Step 7 until a person confirms them.
industry_and_service_tags: Tags use the controlled vocabulary in config.py (INDUSTRY_TAGS, SERVICE_TAGS) so that matching is a deterministic set comparison.

entries.summary: No data analytics, AI or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
entries.clause_text: In consideration of the Client disclosing to the Supplier its Confidential Information, including its revenue strategies, pricing models and Guest Data, the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
entries.end_date_basis: Term to 14 Mar 2028 plus 18-month Restricted Period (clauses 1.14, 6.1)

waivers.covers: Seaside Hotels LLC, Muscat, Oman - demand-forecasting SOW only

entries.summary: No soliciting for employment the other party's staff who were directly involved in the services.
entries.clause_text: During the Term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other Party who was directly involved in the Services, save through general advertisements not targeted at such employees.

entries.summary: No implementation, reseller or referral partnership with any competing cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform in India or the GCC (applies to affiliates).
entries.clause_text: In consideration of the Referral Fees, market development funds and other benefits under this Agreement, during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.

entries.summary: Most-favoured-customer: Crestline's rates must be no less favourable than rates offered by AtliQ or its affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services; lower rates apply to Crestline retroactively.
entries.clause_text: Supplier represents and warrants that the rates, fees and other commercial terms offered to Crestline under this Agreement are and shall remain no less favorable than those offered by Supplier or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services during the Term.

entries.summary: IP in the deliverables, including PipeKit components incorporated into them, is assigned to Northwind on payment.
entries.clause_text: All Intellectual Property Rights in the Deliverables, including any software, tools, frameworks, libraries and pre-existing materials incorporated into the Deliverables, shall vest in the Client absolutely upon payment of the Charges for the relevant Milestone.
